economic_hypothesis: The paired-month candidate's much larger long-path and full-forward profit margins should survive severe proportional cost stress without losing selection epoch breadth, active-component breadth or the accepted bounded July stability relation.

fixed_cost_books.observed_cost_unit: actual net minus doubled-cost stressed net
fixed_cost_books.formula: actual net minus (cost multiplier minus 1) times observed cost unit
fixed_cost_books.selection_detail: Candidate lifecycle-level books preserve close chronology and provide profit factor, closed-balance drawdown, four epochs and five active components. The control source provides exact aggregate books only.
fixed_cost_books.forward_detail: Candidate lifecycle-level books preserve full June/July chronology and month slices. The control source provides exact aggregate books only.

selection: Candidate 4x net is strictly positive and strictly exceeds active Live control 4x net.
Candidate 4x profit factor is at least 1.25 and retains at least 75% of candidate 1x net.

forward: Candidate full-forward 4x net is strictly positive and strictly exceeds active Live control 4x net.
Candidate full-forward 4x profit factor is at least 1.10 and retains at least 75% of candidate 1x net.
